[4] repair-manual.pdf p.3
The Northstar is our most repaired product by a wide margin, which is a function of how
many we sell and of how it is used, not of any weakness. Nearly every Northstar fault is one
of four things: a clogged generator, a dry pump cup, a torn mantle, or the wrong fuel. Ask
about the fuel first. The Northstar burns Clearburn white gas or unleaded gasoline. It does
not burn kerosene, and a tank that has had kerosene in it will have a varnished generator
and a sticky check valve. That is a paid repair even inside the warranty period.
Tools for the Northstar bench: 11 mm and 13 mm open-ended wrenches, the generator
wrench (part T-ND2, the thin 9 mm one with the bent handle), a small flat screwdriver, the
pump cup oil bottle, a nylon brush, and the torque driver set to 2.5 N·m for checking.
Generator tube replacement
The generator (part G-GEN2) is the tube that runs up through the burner and carries fuel
from the tank to the mantles. Signs of a bad generator are a weak yellow flame that will not
steady, pulsing light, and a tank that holds pressure but will not deliver it. The part is
$13.00, so a typical generator replacement on a yellow tag comes to $38.00 with the bench
fee.

[5] fuel-safety.md > The fuels we sell
## The fuels we sell

Clearburn White Gas (LS-FUEL1) is sold in 1-quart cans at $12.99. It is a naphtha fuel, highly
refined, with no additives, and it is what the Northstar was designed around. Clearburn Lamp
Oil (LS-OIL1) is sold in 1-quart bottles at $9.99; it is a clear paraffin oil for wick lanterns
and lamps. We do not sell kerosene. K-1 kerosene is available at most hardware stores and some
fuel stations; buy it in a container marked for kerosene, never in a gasoline can.

Shelf life of Clearburn white gas is 5 years in a sealed can and about 1 year once the can has
been opened; write the date you opened it on the can with a marker. Lamp oil keeps indefinitely
if the bottle is closed. Old white gas does not become dangerous, but it gums the generator and
the lantern will burn poorly. If a can has been open for more than a year, dispose of it as
described below and buy fresh.

Question: How often should the pump cup on a Northstar be oiled?
answer: Oil the pump cup with 3 drops of Clearburn pump oil every 10 fills [1].

### Lost

A package is treated as lost when 10 business days have passed since the expected delivery date
with no delivery scan. At that point customer service files a claim with the carrier and, without
waiting for the claim to settle, ships a replacement at no charge. If the original package later
turns up, the customer is asked to refuse it or to return it with a free prepaid label. Lost
package replacements over $500 need Tomas Reyes's approval under the Three Lights rule, like any
other credit of that size.

A package that tracking shows as delivered but that the customer did not receive is handled the
same way after a 3 business day wait, during which the customer checks with neighbors and the
building office. The carrier is asked for the GPS delivery scan.

[2] customer-service-playbook.md > Lost in transit
### Lost in transit

A package counts as lost when it has not arrived 10 business days after the expected delivery
date shown in tracking. Before that, ask the customer to check with neighbors and the carrier.
Once a package is lost, ship a replacement first and file the carrier claim afterwards; the
customer does not wait for the carrier. Note the carrier claim number on the ticket. If the
replacement is also fuel, confirm the address is not a PO box.

A package shown as delivered that the customer says did not arrive is handled the same way after
a 2-business-day wait, with one exception: for orders over $400, which require a signature, pull
the signature image from the carrier before replacing.

[3] shipping.md > Late
### Late

A package is late when it has not arrived by the last day of its delivery window. Agents should
first check the carrier's tracking; most late packages are moving and arrive within two business
days. For an expedited or overnight order that misses its window, the difference between the
service paid for and standard shipping is refunded without the customer asking.

[4] shipping.md > Lost, late and damaged packages
## Lost, late and damaged packages

[5] faq.md > My package says delivered but I don't have it. What now?
### My package says delivered but I don't have it. What now?

Check with neighbors and your building's office first; most packages turn up within a day. If it
has not arrived 10 business days after the expected delivery date, write to us with the order
number and we will ship a replacement before the carrier claim is settled.

Question: How long before a package that never showed up counts as lost?
answer: A package counts as lost once 10 business days have passed since its expected delivery date with no delivery scan [1][2].

### Paid time off (PTO)

Full-time employees earn 15 days of PTO in each of their first three years and 20 days a year once
they have completed three years of service. PTO accrues monthly, in twelve equal parts, on the last

December 31. Unused PTO is paid out when you leave, as Maryland requires when a written policy
says so, and this policy says so.

requests for the week of Thanksgiving and the two weeks before Christmas are approved on a
first-come basis and are limited to two people per showroom at a time.

[2] employee-handbook.md > Pay
## Pay

Everyone is paid twice a month, on the 15th and on the last day of the month. When a pay date falls
on a weekend or a bank holiday, pay is deposited the business day before. Pay is by direct deposit;
paper checks are available on request from Harold Nkemelu's office and are mailed, not held.

Pay periods run from the 1st through the 15th and from the 16th through the end of the month.
Hourly employees are paid for the period that ended on the pay date; salaried employees are paid

effect with the pay period beginning March 1.

is through the Guideline link in Gusto; contributions start with the next pay period.

begins on the first day of the month after 30 days of full-time employment. The company pays 75% of
the employee premium and 50% of the premium for dependents. Open enrollment runs November 1
through November 20 each year, for coverage starting January 1. Outside open enrollment you can
change your election only after a qualifying life event, within 30 days of the event.

- New Year's Day
- Memorial Day
- Independence Day
- Labor Day

- Christmas Day

on Christmas Eve.

## Lighting and ventilation

Light fuel lanterns outdoors, in a tent vestibule with the door open, or in a room with a window
open. Every fuel lantern produces carbon monoxide, and the Northstar produces enough that it
must never be used in a closed tent, a camper, a vehicle or a small room. The Hagerstown and the
Heritage produce less but are not exempt. If you use a fuel lamp indoors regularly, fit a carbon
monoxide alarm in that room.

Light the Northstar with the control valve barely open and a match or lighter held at the
mantle from below; open the valve once the mantles glow. If the lantern flares, close the valve
and wait for the flame to settle before trying again. Light wick lanterns with the wick turned
low and raise it slowly; a wick turned up too fast smokes and the flame can jump.

Keep lanterns on a flat, stable surface or hung from a hook rated for the weight. The Northstar
weighs 2.4 kg full and is top-heavy. Keep it a metre from tent walls, bedding and anything that
can burn, and keep children and pets away from it; the globe is hot enough to burn skin for
20 minutes after the lantern is turned off.

answer: Tighten the generator fittings hand-tight plus a quarter turn, never more than 2.5 N·m, since the brass strips easily. The generator nut at the base of the burner is tightened the same way [4].
